# Libraries

```{r}
suppressMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressMessages(library(data.table))
suppressMessages(library(magrittr))
library(ggplot2)
library(devtools)
library(rsample)

CENSUS_YEAR = 2018.5
MALAWI_CENSUS_POP = 17563749

pop_scaling_factor = 97.23887 # Change reports to overlap with census year

datestring <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
```

```{r}
# DALY calculation parameters
discount_percent = 0.03
discount_start_year = 2025
infected_weight = 0.274
art_weight = 0.078

# Costing

CET = 500
ppyOnART = 194

# Colors
palette <- c(
  "black", "#C41000", "#E69F00", "#0072B2","#117733",
   "#DDCC77", "#D55E00","#882255", "#56B4E9"
)
```

## Define functions
```{r}
bt_mean <- function(splits, colname){
  x <- as.data.frame(analysis(splits))
  mean(x[[colname]])
}

calculate.CI.by.metric = function(data, scenario.name, metric, n = 500){
  bt_resamples <- bootstraps(data %>% filter(scenario_name == scenario.name), times = n)
  
  bt_resamples$mean.metric <- map_dbl(bt_resamples$splits, bt_mean, metric)
  metric_95 <- quantile(bt_resamples$mean.metric, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  return(
      data.frame(
      scenario_name = scenario.name, 
      metric = metric,
      metric.mean = mean(bt_resamples$mean.metric),
      metric.lb = metric_95[[1]], 
      metric.ub = metric_95[[2]]
    )
  )
}

format_sig3 <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(val) {
    if (is.na(val)) return(NA_character_)
    if (abs(val) > 0 & abs(val) < 1) {
      formatC(signif(val, 3), digits=3, format="fg", flag="#")
    } else {
      formatC(round(val), format="d")
    }
  }, character(1))
}
```

```{r}
  sim.results.retention <- sim.results.retention %>% select(names(sim.results.linkage)), 
  sim.results.self <- sim.results.self %>% select(names(sim.results.linkage)), 
  sim.results.linkage
  )

sim.results.pop.scaling <- sim.results %>% 
      filter(Year == CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
      group_by(sim.id) %>%
      summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'keep') %>% 
      mutate(pop.scaling.factor = MALAWI_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

sim.results <- sim.results %>% 
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.id")
  )
```

```{r}
  experiment_path = input_path,
  scenario_name = 'daly.all',
  summarize_columns = c("Newly.Infected", "Newly.Tested.Positive", "Newly.Tested.Negative",
                        "Population","Infected", "On_ART","Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                        "Diagnosed",
                        "Initiate_Background_PrEP", "Initiate_Intervention_PrEP", "OnART1_defaulter_tracer", "HIV_SelfTest",
                        "EffectiveART_Linkage_Services","EffectiveART","NonSuppressiveART_staging","NonSuppressiveART",
                        "HCTTestingLoop1","Program_VMMC","Needs_PMTCT_Diagnostic_Test"),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Gender", "Age"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)

sim.results.combination <- rbind(
  sim.results.base.v4,
  sim.results.prep.v4,
  sim.results.self.v4,
  sim.results.retention.v4,
  sim.results.linkage.v4,
  sim.results.self.linkage.v4,
  sim.results.self.linkage.retention.v4,
  sim.results.all.v4
  )

sim.results.pop.scaling <- sim.results.combination %>% 
      filter(Year == CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
      group_by(sim.id) %>%
      summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'keep') %>% 
      mutate(pop.scaling.factor = MALAWI_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

sim.results.combination <- sim.results.combination %>% 
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.id")
  )
```

## Generate basic metrics tables
```{r}
time.series.metrics.disaggregated <- sim.results.combination %>%
  mutate(Year = ceiling(Year) - 1) %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2025.5, Year <= 2046, Age >= 25) %>% 
  group_by(Year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population*pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)/2,
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            HIV_SelfTest = sum( HIV_SelfTest * pop_scaling_factor),
            Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * pop_scaling_factor), 
            OnART1_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor), 
            EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = sum(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * pop.scaling.factor),
            .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Off_ART = PLHIV - On_ART) 

time.series.metrics.disaggregated %>% write_csv(paste0("HIVMC_AI/basic_metrics_",datestring,".csv"))

time.series.metrics.disaggregated <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated %>%
  mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(Year - discount_start_year) ) %>%
  mutate(On_ART.discount = On_ART * discount_factor,
         HIV_SelfTest.discount = HIV_SelfTest * discount_factor,
         Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount = Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * discount_factor,
         OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount = OnART1_defaulter_tracer * discount_factor,
         EffectiveART_Linkage_Services.discount = EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * discount_factor)

data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 <- time.series.metrics.disaggregated %>%

data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 <- data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% merge(
```

## Generate Dalys tables
```{r}
data_by_age_year <- sim.results.combination %>% #sim.results.v2 %>%
  filter(Year >= 2025.5) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
     Infected = sum(Infected),
     On_ART = sum(On_ART),
     pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
     .groups = "drop_last"
   )

data_by_age_year$Year_Integer <- floor((data_by_age_year$Year-0.5))

m2 <- data_by_age_year %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
          Infected = mean(Infected),
          On_ART = mean(On_ART),
          pop_scaling_factor = mean(pop_scaling_factor),
          .groups = "drop_last"
         )

m2 <- m2 %>%
        mutate(On_ART_calib = On_ART*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_calib = Infected*pop_scaling_factor,
        Died_from_HIV_calib = Died_from_HIV*pop_scaling_factor,
        Infected_off_ART_calib = (Infected - On_ART)*pop_scaling_factor)

life_expectancy = 80
m2$Age <- ifelse(m2$Age >life_expectancy, life_expectancy, m2$Age)

m3 <- m2 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
      dplyr::select(Year_Integer, Age, scenario_name, sim.ix, 
                    Died_from_HIV_calib, Infected_off_ART_calib, On_ART_calib) %>%
      dplyr::summarise_all(list(median=median))

disability.tibble <- m3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year_Integer, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    infected_untreated = sum(Infected_off_ART_calib_median),
    on_art = sum(On_ART_calib_median)
    ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = Year_Integer)

m4 <- m3 %>% mutate(year_applied = Year_Integer - (Age - (life_expectancy + 1)))

daly.tibble <- merge(
  tibble(scenario_name_ = scenario.names),
  tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ),
  all = TRUE
) %>% 
  merge(  tibble(sim.ix = seq(1,250)), all=TRUE)

daly_expanded <- tibble(
    year = seq(min(m4$Year_Integer), max(m4$Year_Integer))
  ) %>% 
  crossing(
    sim.ix = unique(m4$sim.ix),
    scenario_name = unique(m4$scenario_name)
  )

yll <- daly_expanded %>%
  left_join(m4, by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")) %>%
  filter(Year_Integer <= year, year_applied > year) %>%
  group_by(year, sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(
    yll = sum(Died_from_HIV_calib_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daly = left_join(
  yll, 
  disability.tibble, 
  by=c("year", "sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>%
 replace(is.na(.), 0)

daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly = infected_untreated*infected_weight + on_art*art_weight + yll)
daly <- daly %>% mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(year - discount_start_year) )
daly[daly$year < discount_start_year,'discount_factor'] <- 1.0
daly <- daly %>% mutate(daly_future_discounted = daly*discount_factor )

# Intermediate table!
HIV.DALYs <- daly %>% select(
  Year = year, 
  scenario_name,
  sim.ix,
  HIV.DALY = daly,
  HIV.DALY.discounted = daly_future_discounted)

HIV.DALYs %>% write_csv(paste0("HIVMC_AI/combination_CE_DALY_calculation_",datestring,".csv"))
```

### Generate confidence interval calculations
Aggregate and calculate total DALYs averted
```{r}
HIV.DALYs <- read_csv("HIVMC_AI/combination_CE_DALY_calculation_20260205.csv")

# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 
  
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == 'daly.baseline') %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted
  )

metric.names = c("HIV.DALY", "HIV.DALY.discounted",
                 "HIV.DALY.diff", "HIV.DALY.discounted.diff",
                 "HIV.DALY.pct", "HIV.DALY.discounted.pct")

scenario.names = c("daly.baseline", "daly.prep", "daly.retention", "daly.self.test", "daly.linkage",
                   "daly.self.linkage","daly.self.linkage.retention", "daly.all")

daly.cis = data.frame()

for (i in metric.names){
  for (j in scenario.names) {
    
    #print(c(i,j))
    h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = HIV.DALYs.agg,
      scenario.name = j,
      metric = i)
    
    daly.cis = rbind(daly.cis, h)
  }
}

daly.cis

daly.cis %>% write_csv(paste0("HIVMC_AI/combination_DALY_calculation_CIs_",datestring,".csv"))

```

```{r}
costs.data <- merge(
  metrics.data %>% 
    filter(scenario_name %in% c("daly.baseline", "daly.prep", "daly.retention", "daly.self.test", "daly.linkage")) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = "scenario_name",
      names_from = "metric",
      values_from = c("metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub"),
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
      rename_with(~ sub("^metric\\.", "", .), starts_with("metric.")),
    daly.cis %>%  
      filter(scenario_name %in% c("daly.baseline", "daly.prep", "daly.retention", "daly.self.test", "daly.linkage")) %>% 
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = "scenario_name",
        names_from = "metric",
        values_from = c("metric.mean", "metric.lb", "metric.ub")
    ) %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("^metric\\.", "", .), starts_with("metric.")),
  by = c("scenario_name")
)

cost.threshold.calculation <- costs.data %>% 
  select(scenario_name, 
         mean_On_ART.diff, mean_On_ART.discount.diff,
         mean_HIV.DALY.diff, mean_HIV.DALY.discounted.diff,
         mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer, mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount,
         mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP, mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount,
         mean_HIV_SelfTest, mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount,
         mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services, mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services.discount) %>% 
  mutate(
    undiscounted.num = - CET * mean_HIV.DALY.diff - ppyOnART * mean_On_ART.diff,
    discounted.num = - CET * mean_HIV.DALY.discounted.diff - ppyOnART * mean_On_ART.discount.diff
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ART.cost = case_when(
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer),
    ART.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount),
    PREP.cost = case_when(
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP),
    PREP.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount),
    self.testing.cost = case_when(
      mean_HIV_SelfTest == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_HIV_SelfTest != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_HIV_SelfTest),
    self.testing.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/mean_HIV_SelfTest.discount),
    linkage.cost = case_when(
      mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services),
    linkage.discount.cost = case_when(
      mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services.discount != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/mean_EffectiveART_Linkage_Services.discount)
    
  )
  
cost.threshold.calculation %>% 
  select(scenario_name, 
         ART.cost, ART.discount.cost,
         PREP.cost, PREP.discount.cost,
         self.testing.cost, self.testing.discount.cost,
         linkage.cost, linkage.discount.cost)
```



# Calculate CIs on Upper Bound Cost Thresholds

```{r}
HIV.DALYs <- read_csv("HIVMC_AI/combination_CE_DALY_calculation.csv")
# Aggregate over years and calculate DALYs averted
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs %>% 
  filter(scenario_name %in% c("daly.baseline", "daly.prep", "daly.retention", "daly.self.test", "daly.linkage")) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(HIV.DALY= sum(HIV.DALY),
            HIV.DALY.discounted = sum(HIV.DALY.discounted), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  ungroup() 
  
HIV.DALYs.agg <- HIV.DALYs.agg %>% merge(
    HIV.DALYs.agg %>% filter(scenario_name == 'daly.baseline') %>% 
      select(sim.ix, 
             HIV.DALY.baseline = HIV.DALY,
             HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline = HIV.DALY.discounted),
    by = c('sim.ix')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.diff = HIV.DALY - HIV.DALY.baseline,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.diff = HIV.DALY.discounted - HIV.DALY.discounted.baseline
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    HIV.DALY.pct = HIV.DALY.diff/HIV.DALY,
    HIV.DALY.discounted.pct = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff/HIV.DALY.discounted
  )

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging <- merge(
  HIV.DALYs.agg %>% 
    select(sim.ix, scenario_name, HIV.DALY.diff, HIV.DALY.discounted.diff),
  data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% 
    select(sim.ix, scenario_name, 
           On_ART.diff, On_ART.discount.diff,
           HIV_SelfTest, HIV_SelfTest.discount,
           Initiate_Intervention_PrEP, Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount,
           ART = OnART1_defaulter_tracer,
           ART.discount = OnART1_defaulter_tracer.discount,
           Linkage = EffectiveART_Linkage_Services,
           Linkage.discount = EffectiveART_Linkage_Services.discount),
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  ) %>% merge(
    data.metrics.aggregated.2025.2045 %>% 
    select(scenario_name, sim.ix, 
           ART.maintenance = On_ART,
           ART.maintenance.discount = On_ART.discount),
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
) %>% 
  mutate(
    undiscounted.num = - CET * HIV.DALY.diff - ppyOnART * On_ART.diff,
    discounted.num = - CET * HIV.DALY.discounted.diff - ppyOnART * On_ART.discount.diff
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ART.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART),
    ART.discount.cost = case_when(
      ART.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      ART.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/ART.discount),
    ART.maintenance.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART.maintenance),
    ART.maintenance.discount.cost = case_when(
      ART == 0 ~ 0,
      ART != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/ART.maintenance.discount),
    PREP.cost = case_when(
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP == 0 ~ 0,
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/Initiate_Intervention_PrEP),
    PREP.discount.cost = case_when(
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/Initiate_Intervention_PrEP.discount),
    Self.testing.cost = case_when(
      HIV_SelfTest == 0 ~ 0,
      HIV_SelfTest != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/HIV_SelfTest),
    Self.testing.discount.cost = case_when(
      HIV_SelfTest.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      HIV_SelfTest.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/HIV_SelfTest.discount),
    linkage.cost = case_when(
      Linkage == 0 ~ 0,
      Linkage != 0 ~ undiscounted.num/Linkage),
    linkage.discount.cost = case_when(
      Linkage.discount == 0 ~ 0,
      Linkage.discount != 0 ~ discounted.num/Linkage.discount)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ARTcosts_fraction = ppyOnART * On_ART.diff/undiscounted.num,
    ARTcosts_fraction.discount = ppyOnART * On_ART.discount.diff/ discounted.num)

#cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging

cost.threshold.calculation.CIs <- data.frame()

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "daly.retention",
      metric = "ART.cost")
cost.threshold.calculation.CIs = rbind(cost.threshold.calculation.CIs, h)

h <- calculate.CI.by.metric(
      data = cost.threshold.calculation.CIs.staging,
      scenario.name = "daly.retention",
      metric = "ART.discount.cost")
```

### Annual indicators
```{r}
dat.males.15 <- sim.results.combination %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year - .5)) %>% 
  filter(Gender ==0, Age >=15) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(
    Population = sum(Population * pop.scaling.factor/2),
    PLHIV = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor/2),
    Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Died_from_HIV = sum(Newly.Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop.scaling.factor/2)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(
    Population = mean(Population), 
    PLHIV = mean(PLHIV),
    Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
    On_ART = mean(On_ART)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Population, PLHIV, Newly.Infected, Died_from_HIV, On_ART),
    names_to = "indicator"
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(scenario_name, indicator), 
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = value
  ) %>% 
  mutate(group = 1) %>% 
  mutate(model = "emod", iso3 = "MWI", sex = "male", age_group = "15-49")

  select(model, iso3, scenario_name, indicator, population, sex, age_group, "2018":"2046", group) %>% 
  arrange(scenario_name, population, group)
```

### Summary Indicators
```{r}
custom_order2 <- c("daly.baseline", "daly.retention","daly.prep","daly.self.test","daly.linkage","daly.self.linkage","daly.self.linkage.retention", "daly.all")

dat.summary <- merge(
  metrics.data %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(scenario_name),
      names_from = metric,
      values_from = metric.mean
    ) %>% 
    select(scenario_name, Newly.Infected, Newly.Infected.diff,
           Died_from_HIV, Died_from_HIV.diff),
  daly.cis %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = scenario_name, 
      names_from = metric,
      values_from = metric.mean
    ) %>% 
    select(
      scenario_name,
      DALYs = HIV.DALY, DALYs_disc = HIV.DALY.discounted,
      HIV.DALY.diff,HIV.DALY.discounted.diff),
   by = c("scenario_name")
) %>% 
  mutate(model = "EMOD", Intervention = "") %>% 
  mutate(Scenario = factor(scenario_name, levels = custom_order2)) %>% 
  select(model, Intervention, Scenario,
         Total_New_Infections = Newly.Infected,
         Inf_Averted = Newly.Infected.diff,
         Total_HIV_Related_Deaths = Died_from_HIV,
         Deaths_Averted = Died_from_HIV.diff,
         DALYs, DALYs_disc,
         DALYs_Averted = HIV.DALY.diff,
         DALYS_Averted_disc = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff) %>% 
  arrange(Scenario)

dat.summary %>% write_csv(paste0("HIVMC_AI/summary_indicators_",datestring,".csv"))

```

```{r}
adults.plot.dat <- sim.results.combination %>%
  filter(Age >= 15) %>%
  mutate(Off_ART = Infected - On_ART) %>% 
  mutate(Year = floor(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>%
  summarize(Infected = sum(Infected* pop_scaling_factor/2), 
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2),
            Off_ART = sum(Off_ART * pop_scaling_factor/2)) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>%
  summarize(
    Infected = mean(Infected),
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
    Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected),
    On_ART = mean(On_ART),
    Off_ART = mean(Off_ART)
  )
```

## PLHIV

```{r}
plhiv.adults <- adults.plot.dat %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2020, Year < 2045) %>%
  filter(scenario_name %in% c("daly.baseline","daly.linkage","daly.prep","daly.retention", "daly.self.test")) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Infected, color = scenario_name ),
            linewidth = 1,
            show.legend = FALSE ) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Year", breaks = seq(2020,2045,5)) +
  scale_y_continuous("People Living With HIV") +
  theme_minimal() + theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        #axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        #axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        #plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        text = element_text(family = "sans"),
```

# Generate estimates of incremental costs

Apparently we are going a completely different direction than the one I brought up in December, so here is where I calculate the incremental costs

## Parameters

```{r}
# DALY calculation parameters
discount_percent = 0.03
discount_start_year = 2025
infected_weight = 0.274
art_weight = 0.078

# Costing

CET = 500
ppyOnART = 194
tdf.cost.mwi = 66.89
pmtct.cost.mwi = 13.03
test.cost.mwi = 1.95#12.75
vmmc.cost.mwi = 32.08
art.adh.cost.mwi = 11.32 

```



## Costing

```{r}
costing.dat <- sim.results.combination %>% 
  filter(Year >= 2025.5) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year) %>% 
  summarize(
    Needs_PMTCT_Diagnostic_Test = sum(Needs_PMTCT_Diagnostic_Test * pop.scaling.factor),
    Program_VMMC = sum(Program_VMMC * pop.scaling.factor),
    HCTTestingLoop1 = sum(HCTTestingLoop1 * pop.scaling.factor),
    NonSuppressiveART = sum(NonSuppressiveART * pop.scaling.factor),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = sum(NonSuppressiveART_staging * pop.scaling.factor), 
    EffectiveART = sum(EffectiveART * pop.scaling.factor),
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = sum(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * pop.scaling.factor),
    HIV_SelfTest = sum(HIV_SelfTest * pop.scaling.factor),
    OnART1_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_defaulter_tracer * pop.scaling.factor),
    Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * pop.scaling.factor),
    Initiate_Background_PrEP = sum(Initiate_Background_PrEP * pop.scaling.factor),
    On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop.scaling.factor/2),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(
    Needs_PMTCT_Diagnostic_Test = mean(Needs_PMTCT_Diagnostic_Test),
    Program_VMMC = mean(Program_VMMC),
    HCTTestingLoop1 = mean(HCTTestingLoop1),
    NonSuppressiveART = mean(NonSuppressiveART),
    NonSuppressiveART_staging = mean(NonSuppressiveART_staging),
    EffectiveART = mean(EffectiveART),
    EffectiveART_Linkage_Services = mean(EffectiveART_Linkage_Services),
    HIV_SelfTest = mean(HIV_SelfTest),
    OnART1_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_defaulter_tracer),
    Initiate_Intervention_PrEP = mean(Initiate_Intervention_PrEP),
    Initiate_Background_PrEP = mean(Initiate_Background_PrEP),
    On_ART = mean(On_ART),
    .groups = 'drop_last'
  ) %>% 
  # calculate cost
  mutate(Total_Cost = On_ART * ppyOnART + Initiate_Background_PrEP * tdf.cost.mwi + Initiate_Intervention_PrEP * tdf.cost.mwi + 
         Program_VMMC * vmmc.cost.mwi +  HCTTestingLoop1*test.cost.mwi +  EffectiveART_Linkage_Services * art.adh.cost.mwi + 
           HIV_SelfTest * test.cost.mwi + OnART1_defaulter_tracer * art.adh.cost.mwi) %>% 
  mutate(discount_factor = (1 - discount_percent)^(Year - discount_start_year) ) %>% 
  mutate(Total_Cost_discounted = Total_Cost*discount_factor) %>%
  group_by(scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(Total_Cost = sum(Total_Cost),
            Total_Cost_discounted = sum(Total_Cost_discounted))

costing.dat <- costing.dat %>% merge(
  costing.dat %>% filter(scenario_name == 'daly.baseline') %>% 
  select(Total_Cost.baseline = Total_Cost, Total_Cost_discounted.baseline = Total_Cost_discounted)
) %>% 
  mutate(Incremental_Cost = Total_Cost - Total_Cost.baseline,
         Incremental_Cost_discounted = Total_Cost_discounted - Total_Cost_discounted.baseline)

```


## Summary Indicators
```{r}
custom_order2 <- c("daly.baseline", "daly.retention","daly.prep","daly.self.test","daly.linkage","daly.self.linkage","daly.self.linkage.retention", "daly.all")


dat.summary <- merge(
  metrics.data %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(scenario_name),
      names_from = metric,
      values_from = metric.mean
    ) %>% 
    select(scenario_name, Newly.Infected, Newly.Infected.diff,
           Died_from_HIV, Died_from_HIV.diff),
  daly.cis %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = scenario_name, 
      names_from = metric,
      values_from = metric.mean
    ) %>% 
    select(
      scenario_name,
      DALYs = HIV.DALY, DALYs_discounted = HIV.DALY.discounted,
      HIV.DALY.diff,HIV.DALY.discounted.diff),
   by = c("scenario_name")
) %>% 
  mutate(model = "EMOD", Intervention = "") %>% 
  mutate(Scenario = factor(scenario_name, levels = custom_order2)) %>% 
  select(model, Intervention, Scenario,
         Total_New_Infections = Newly.Infected,
         Inf_Averted = Newly.Infected.diff,
         Total_HIV_Related_Deaths = Died_from_HIV,
         Deaths_Averted = Died_from_HIV.diff,
         DALYs, DALYs_discounted,
         DALYs_Averted = HIV.DALY.diff,
         DALYS_Averted_discounted = HIV.DALY.discounted.diff) %>% 
  arrange(Scenario)

dat.summary %>% 
  merge(costing.dat %>% select(Scenario = scenario_name, Total_Cost, Total_Cost_discounted, Incremental_Cost, Incremental_Cost_discounted), by = "Scenario") %>%
  write_csv(paste0("HIVMC_AI/summary_indicators_costing_",datestring,".csv"))

```
